rows: You're brilliant on the mat, I know. I want that first instant before you get hold of me.
You can hit me hard. But a match keeps moving, doesn't it? That's what I need.

Come on, don't make them wait for it! I want this match moving from the first second.

I'm better at showing it than explaining it. Watch the ring.
When the lights hit me I want everyone to forget what number match this is.
Look up. That's the kind of night you're dealing with.
You might keep moving. You've still got to stop me getting my hands on you.
Can you keep that speed after the first hit? That's the question.

Not every pause is wasted time. Wait until you see what I do with mine.
I want them on their feet too. Let's see which of us earns it.
The lights are lovely. Keeping them is the difficult bit.
I heard you: {strength}. I've got to work out the moment when I can get past that.
I accept your {strength} as real. I'm looking for the little gap in that.

Right. Breathe. I'll see you at the bell.

No one else. One fall, and we find out.
All right, down on the mat with you. Show me, quickly.
Stay with me on the canvas for a bit. Can you?

Yeah. That's something we can agree on.
